title: Central banks signal coordinated pause as inflation data diverges
content: Fed, ECB, and Bank of England officials have all indicated rates will hold through Q3 as diverging CPI readings complicate a unified policy path.
author: Sarah Chen

title: Pentagon confirms deployment of additional electronic warfare units
content: Three additional EW battalions will be pre-positioned in eastern Europe.

title: OpenAI competitor Mistral raises €600m at €6bn valuation
content: The Series C round was led by General Atlantic and is the largest in Europe this year.

title: Arctic ice extent hits record July low as Greenland melt accelerates
content: July sea-ice extent is 340,000 km² below the previous record low for this date.

title: WHO declares mpox variant clade Ib a public health emergency
content: The emergency declaration triggers accelerated vaccine-sharing and surveillance protocols.
